name: prman
description: Human-confirmed, end-to-end Draft PR automation for Codex

interface.longDescription: PRman guides Codex from read-only repository discovery through implementation, deterministic quality checks, an exact human confirmation, Draft PR creation, and bounded CI repair. Codex supplies the coding and connected GitHub tools; PRman supplies the workflow and safety boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Use PRman to find a suitable Python issue, implement and verify it, then ask before opening a Draft PR.
Use PRman to fix this GitHub issue, assess the final diff, and prepare an exact Draft PR confirmation.
